name: Chartered Logistics Limited
about: Chartered Logistics Limited provides logistics services dealing in domestic transportation of goods in India. The company offers road transport services, warehousing services, and cost and freight solutions; and freight forwarding, supply chain management, inventory management, distribution, technology, freight transport, and order fulfillment services. It also operates a fleet of approximately 300 owned and attached vehicles. The company operates through various branches. It serves pharmaceuticals, FMCG, cement, power transmission, chemicals, and heavy engineering industries. Chartered Logistics Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
